prompt:
GAME ITEM SPRITE. One single object seen from above at a slight angle, centred, like an item lying on the ground in a top-down strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga lithium house battery: a modern lithium battery for a camping vehicle, with its isolator. Image 1 is our approved lead-acid house battery from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape, its carry strap or its dark grey colour.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 70 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A slimmer, smaller battery box than a lead-acid one, with crisp squared edges, its case a pale blue-grey with a darker blue band around its middle, two neat recessed terminals on its top (one capped red, one capped black), a small raised panel on the top for its management board with a row of tiny cooling slots, and a small pale isolator box with two short cables clipped to its side.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No people, text, letters, numbers, plus or minus signs, logos, brand marks, dials, screens, lights, sparks or shadow beyond the object.
